breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly rejected the instruction to neglect drag force. Instead, it included quadratic aerodynamic drag with C_d = 0.5 and set up the proper force balance equation (weight minus buoyancy = drag), exactly matching the ground truth approach. The generated specification explicitly states 'Assume quadratic aerodynamic drag with drag coefficient C_d = 0.5' and provides the correct balance equation.
